summary: Pass 2 isolated the ultrametric large-child kernel and proved a 2r*MST bound for the remaining transitions. Verified 180 nonuniform-weight configurations and an exact positive-density family excluding coefficient 2 in the stronger kernel. Universal transfer and the immutable original remain unresolved; one research pass remains.
next_test: Prove or parametrically falsify B_r <= 4rW for arbitrary ultrametrics and nonuniform order weights under dominated, nonempty disjoint r-by-r rectangles, using one hierarchy-wide charging invariant. B_r counts transitions whose LCA endpoint children both have more than r leaves. An ultrametric proof still requires extension to general metrics.
